# C4 Mermaid Style Guide

## Global Class Definitions
```mermaid
classDef person fill:#08427b,stroke:#073b6e,color:#ffffff,stroke-width:2px;
classDef internalSystem fill:#1168bd,stroke:#0b4884,color:#ffffff,stroke-width:2px;
classDef container fill:#438dd5,stroke:#3c7fc0,color:#ffffff,stroke-width:2px;
classDef domainService fill:#28a745,stroke:#1e7e34,color:#ffffff,stroke-width:2px;
classDef externalSystem fill:#999999,stroke:#8a8a8a,color:#ffffff,stroke-width:2px;
classDef boundary fill:none,stroke:#444444,stroke-dasharray: 5 5;
